propositions: Authors must understand that risky mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) must be de-risked with concrete fast out-of-loop proofs before committing to the slow loop, per criterion T15.
The packaged guide must describe two permitted fast proof forms: local run or manual probe against the real target, and cleanup must be scoped only to resources created by the throwaway experiment.

The hand-authored overlay enumeration in plan-review-gate.md must be updated from stale T1–T12 range to T1–T15 with validated criterion count of 44, and registry.py module docstring must reflect the same.
The criterion-pins.json manifest must be regenerated to include the T15 pin and align with the packaged guide contract.
All guidance must remain stack-agnostic with no product-specific instructions (Terraform, Docker, etc.) hardcoded into the rules.
